task.title: ContainerVolume stuck in Pending
task.body:
# ContainerVolume stuck in Pending: Docker Desktop 4.94 returns "volume <name> not found"

## Summary
With Docker Desktop 4.94.0 (engine 29.8.2, Windows), DCP never creates missing named volumes. `VolumeReconciler` repeatedly logs `Could not determine whether container volume exists` and the volume stays `Pending`, so dependent containers never start.

## Cause
`docker volume inspect <missing>` now returns:

```
Error response from daemon: volume <name> not found
```

`internal/docker/cli_orchestrator.go` only treats `(?i)no such volume` as `containers.ErrNotFound`, so the error is treated as unknown and `docker volume create` is never reached (`controllers/volume_controller.go`).

## Repro
1. Docker Desktop 4.94.0 / engine 29.8.2
2. AppHost with `.WithDataVolume("some-volume")`, volume not present
3. `aspire start`: the volume stays Pending indefinitely

## Suggested fix
Also match `(?i)volume (.*) not found` in `volumeNotFoundRegEx` (Docker and Podman orchestrators).

## Environment
- Aspire 13.6.1
- Docker Desktop 4.94.0 (241994), client/server 29.8.2, Windows
